assets.intended_use: Today page hero illustration for Psalms reading
assets.prompt: Create one standalone production illustration for a devotional Bible reading site, inspired by the two references: a richly painterly, reverent golden-hour landscape of an ancient olive tree on the left with a substantial twisted trunk and luminous olive-green leaves, and a finely carved wooden lyre harp resting upright among flowers and rocks in the lower-left/center foreground, with the entire harp and all strings clearly visible inside the composition. Let a clear stream run from the center foreground through a peaceful green valley toward the right distance; layered hills and distant mountains catch warm sunset light beneath softly glowing clouds. Keep the tree canopy framing the upper-left without obscuring the harp; place the brightest sun and open valley toward the upper-right. Compose as a complete edge-to-edge 6:5 landscape painting, approximately 1536 x 1280: tree left, harp lower-left to center, stream and valley right. Deep olive greens, muted natural earth, textured bark and stone, luminous but restrained amber-gold highlights, rich fine painterly detail, cinematic natural light, cohesive palette and rendering quality matching the references. Artwork only, full image to every edge; no UI, no lettering, no captions, no logos, no frame or border, no external drop shadow, no humans, no angels, no divine figures. Keep all focal objects comfortably inside the frame and do not rely on later cropping.
processing: converted to WebP quality=90, method=6; no crop or resize
